title: 3D Stamp Generator
description: Text, logo and border stamps as FDM-ready STL / 3MF.

title: Image Prep
description: Black & white, SVG line art (trace, edges, centre line), background removal and colour layers for multi-colour stamps.

title: Lithophane Maker
description: Photo to a backlit lithophane plate, flat or curved, with a frame and a live backlit preview. STL.

title: Layered Colour Art
description: Photo or logo reduced to a few filament colours and printed as stacked steps, one colour per height. Colour 3MF with a filament slot per layer.

title: Name Keychain
description: Type a name: raised letters on a plate that follows them (or a rounded rectangle), with a keyring loop. STL and two-colour 3MF.

title: Cookie Cutter Maker
description: A built-in shape or your own picture's outline as a cookie or clay cutter with a sharp edge and a press flange. STL.

title: Magnets and Ornaments
description: Any shape as a fridge magnet or hanging ornament: raised text or picture, a rim, a pocket for a disc magnet, a loop. STL and two-colour 3MF.

title: Plant Markers
description: A list of plant names to a bed full of garden stakes: raised letters on a head plate with a spike. One STL / 3MF of the set, or a ZIP of one STL each.

title: Listing Photos
description: Turn a 3D file into product photos: pick an angle, backdrop, colour and finish, and download PNGs at Etsy sizes, one or a set of six.

title: Mesh Checker
description: Check a model before it prints: holes, inside-out faces, size against your bed, overhangs that need supports, and walls too thin to print. Can repair it.

title: QR Code Stand
description: QR plate with optional icon and title, plus a slotted base that holds it standing up. STL and colour 3MF.

title: QR Code Keychain
description: QR plate with a split-ring loop, printed as one piece. STL and colour 3MF.

title: 3D Wedding Invite
description: Turn an invitation photo or SVG into a layered 3D print. Opens the invite2svg app (separate site).

title: STL / 3MF Modifier
description: Open an STL or 3MF, then resize, rotate, mirror, drill holes, engrave or raise text, cut in two with pegs, or add a hanging tab. Keeps 3MF parts and colours.

title: Flexi Maker
description: Turn a model into an articulated, print-in-place flexi: cut it into segments joined by ball-and-socket joints. Keeps 3MF colours.
